coolProjects.name: NYC Climate Efficiency Map
coolProjects.description: Interactive web application visualizing NYC building energy efficiency data at unprecedented scale, making government climate disclosure data accessible for public accountability and investigative analysis.
coolProjects.backstory: I conceived and developed this project from inception to production deployment, tackling the massive technical challenge of rendering 61,588 individual building markers without freezing browsers. Using Python and GeoPandas, I built a data pipeline to process and spatially join three NYC government datasets, then created a React/TypeScript frontend with innovative viewport filtering and zoom-based architecture that achieved 99% memory reduction. The result is a production tool that reveals geographic patterns in energy efficiency perfect for investigative journalism, while serving as a genuine public utility for residents and policymakers to understand climate accountability in their neighborhoods.
highlights: 61,588 building markers with 99% memory optimization through viewport filtering
Multi-source government data integration and spatial analysis pipeline
Production deployment serving real public utility for climate accountability
Zoom-based dual-scale architecture revealing city-wide and building-level patterns
